word-reading-hobby.def: enjoying books, stories or articles as a way to relax

word-gardening.def: growing flowers, vegetables or other plants around a home

word-fishing.def: trying to catch animals that live in water with a rod or net

word-camping.def: staying outdoors overnight, usually in a tent

word-hiking.def: taking a long walk on trails in nature

word-photography.def: the art or hobby of taking pictures with a camera

word-drawing.def: a picture made with a pencil, pen or crayon

word-knitting.def: making soft clothes by looping wool with two long needles

word-sewing.def: joining pieces of cloth with a needle and thread

word-crafts.def: activities in which you make decorations or objects by hand

word-volunteering.def: working to help others without being paid

word-meditation.def: a quiet practice of calming your mind, often while sitting still

word-pottery.def: the craft of making bowls and cups from clay

word-woodworking.def: making furniture or other objects from timber

word-origami.def: the Japanese art of folding paper into shapes

word-calligraphy.def: the art of writing in a beautiful, decorative style

word-birdwatching.def: looking at wild animals with feathers outdoors and learning their names

word-karaoke.def: a kind of entertainment where you sing along to recorded music

word-blog.def: a website where someone regularly posts their thoughts or news

word-diy.def: making or repairing things at home on your own instead of paying a professional

word-tent.def: a shelter made of cloth that you put up outdoors to sleep in

word-sleeping-bag.def: a warm, soft bag that you sleep in when you are outdoors

word-campfire.def: a small outdoor fire made to cook food or stay warm at night in the wild

word-campsite.def: a place in nature where people can put up tents and stay overnight

word-free-time.def: hours when you do not have to work or study and can do what you like

word-club.def: a group of people who meet regularly because they share an interest

word-knit.def: to make clothes by looping wool with two long needles

word-sew.def: to join pieces of cloth using a needle and thread

word-go-fishing.def: to spend time trying to catch animals that live in water

word-camp.def: to sleep outdoors in a tent for a night or longer

word-hike.def: to walk long distances on trails in nature

word-take-photos.def: to record pictures with a camera

word-journal.def: a notebook where you write about your thoughts, experiences or ideas

word-diary.def: a book where you write down what happened each day

word-magic-trick.def: a clever act that seems impossible, done to amuse an audience

word-model-kit.def: a box of parts that you put together to make a small copy of a car, plane or ship
